== Objectives ==
Rikki Fizmask wants you to pillage the Stormwrought Ruins on Balor and return to her at the Gullwing Wreckage.
* [[Balorian Treasure]] (10)

== Description ==
When we crashlanded here on this island, we noticed that most of our cargo had dropped into the wide expanses of the ocean. While we still have a good chunk of it secured, it’s not nearly enough to satisfy our recipients in Booty Bay. Yunie and the others have their hands full repairing the zeppelin and making sure we don’t actually get eaten by monstrous crustaceans. I on the other hand had the golden opportunity to scout the island when we were looking for Verix a while back. And wouldn’t you know it: there is a giant castle atop the cliffs. You can probably guess what I am hinting at. While I am not as crazy and suicidal as Verix, I would be remiss to pass up this opportunity to grab some valuables no goblin has ever seen before.

Which is where you come in. Grab some friends or pay someone if you don’t have any and grab as many valuables as you can get from within that castle on the other side of Balor. It will pay off, trust me!

==Rewards==
You will receive:
* [[Trusty Goblin Shiv]]
* 2800 XP

== Progress ==
You’re tough - or foolish - enough to come to this cursed place on your own, so I’m sure you’ll have no problems going in there and coming back out unharmed - mostly, atleast.

== Completion ==
Wow, what a haul. Might not be exactly what we were supposed to be delivering, but I doubt those greedy bastards in their pirate cove will complain that much. Thank you so much, <name>. We owe you big time. You can have this for your troubles, it always gave me the best of luck - the fact I’m still here is proof of that.
